CustomField.description: DERIVED - DO NOT HAND-EDIT. Number of NDA__c records on this disposition whose Status__c is Signed, maintained by the NDA_Signed_Rollup flow alongside NDA_Count__c. Signed ALONE is the release condition (design Q6): the document states one condition - "information is released only once every NDA is signed" - so requiring a counter-signature date as well would be an invention. A Signed NDA later moved to Declined leaves this count, so the gate re-blocks, which is the intended behaviour. Rows created before this field existed hold null rather than 0, which is why every reader wraps it in BLANKVALUE.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically from the NDA records linked to this disposition. To change it, mark an NDA Signed on the NDA record; do not edit it here.
CustomField.label: Signed NDA Count
